children: Equity benchmarks ended 0.4 percent lower on August 31, with negative market breadth. About 2,078 shares declined compared with 1,160 advancing shares on the NSE. The market needs to reclaim and sustain above key moving averages for the uptrend to resume; until then, consolidation may continue. Here are some short-term trading ideas to consider:
Mehul Kothari, VP – Technical Research at Anand Rathi

Hindustan Copper has shown a strong recovery from the Rs 480–500 zone and has maintained a broader higher-high, higher-low structure. The stock is currently consolidating after a sharp upmove, with Rs 520–525 acting as an important support zone. The broader trend remains positive as long as the stock sustains above the Rs 520–525 zone.

RSI (14) is at 50.15 and has cooled off towards the neutral zone, indicating a healthy momentum reset and providing room for a fresh upside move. The current consolidation appears corrective rather than a reversal of the broader uptrend, and a reversal from the support zone followed by a move above Rs 540 could trigger fresh buying interest and support an upside move towards Rs 620. Traders may consider entering long positions in the Rs 530–520 zone.

Sagility has formed a strong base around the Rs 40–42 zone and has recently broken out of its consolidation, with Rs 43–44 now acting as an immediate support zone. The stock has moved above the Ichimoku Cloud and is sustaining above the key cloud zone, indicating a positive trend reversal and strengthening the overall bullish structure.
RSI is at 68.32, reflecting strong momentum, while the rising RSI supports further upside potential. The recent breakout, coupled with sustained momentum,
suggests that the stock could continue its upward trajectory as long as it holds above the immediate support zone. Traders may consider entering long positions in the Rs 44–46 zone.

Graphite India has corrected from the Rs 760 mark and has found support near the Supertrend indicator and medium-term moving averages, indicating buying interest emerging at lower levels. The stock has also retraced around 38.2 percent of its previous upmove, which is an important Fibonacci retracement level and provides a favourable risk-reward opportunity.

The current correction appears to be a healthy pullback within the broader positive structure, and a reversal from the current support zone could trigger fresh buying interest and resume the upward move. Traders may consider entering long positions near Rs 700.
Jay Thakkar, Vice President & Head of Derivatives and Quant Research at ICICI Securities

Axis Bank has taken support near Rs 1,200-1,220 range on multiple occasions and there has been short covering witnessed in the recent bounce back, hence there is a higher possibility of further up move from hereon. The Nifty Private Sector Bank index has been outperforming the PSU Banking Index, hence a further up move from hereon is expected.

As per the options data, there has been Put additions at several strikes from Rs 1,260 to Rs 1,180 which will act as a support whereas Rs 1,300 strike is the one which has the highest Call base, hence that is the 1st target and above that will witness further short covering. The stock is trading near it maximum pain level of Rs 1,260, hence above it will be bullish from hereon. Buy Axis Bank Futures in the range of Rs 1,250-1,265, with a stop-loss below Rs 1,230.

Apollo Hospitals has been consolidating within a range of Rs 9,000-8,600 since past few trading sessions and with that it has so far witnessed long built up indicating that the overall trend is bullish. In the recent consolidation it has witnessed some profit booking and long unwinding, however, the overall outlook is bullish and the range is likely to be broken on the upside.

As per the options data, Rs 9,000 strike has the highest Call built up which when taken off will lead to further uptrend. The maximum pain level is Rs 8,900 and the stock has just closed around it, hence above the same it is sustain can lead to a breakout beyond Rs 9,000 levels as well. Buy Apollo Hospitals Futures in the range of Rs 8,900-8,920 with a stop-loss below Rs 8,750.

Oberoi Realty has witnessed long built up overall in its previous uptrend, however, it did witness some long unwinding in the recent consolidation or correction, however, the open interest has reduced once again and the leverage has come down making a case of long additions once again.
The prices have corrected up to the mean of the last 20 days and till that is held the uptrend is likely to resume.

As per the options data, above Rs 1,900 strike there will be huge Call unwinding and a sharp up move. The maximum pain is also at Rs 1,900 thus it becomes a critical level and above the same there will be strong up move. Buy Oberoi Realty Futures in the range of Rs 1,860-1,880 with a stop-loss below Rs 1,830.
Vidnyan Sawant, Head of Research at GEPL Capital

TD Power Systems has been maintaining a robust structural uptrend, marked by a consistent formation of higher tops and higher bottoms, indicating sustained buying interest. The stock has recently witnessed a breakout from a nine-day shallow retracement, signaling potential resumption of the primary up move.

The stock is comfortably positioned above its key 12-, 20-, and 50-DEMA, reaffirming the positive trend structure. Furthermore, the ADX is above 30, with +DI above 30 and -DI near 14, indicating strong trend strength with a bullish directional bias. Overall, the technical setup remains constructive, favoring continuation of the uptrend.

Gabriel India has been sustaining a well-defined rising channel since March 2026, forming a consistent sequence of higher tops and higher bottoms, indicating a strong bullish price structure. The stock has recently rebounded from the lower boundary of the channel and witnessed a bullish polarity shift, with the previous resistance zone of October 2025 now acting as a key support, indicating potential resumption of the primary uptrend.

Volume participation has surged above its 20-day average, further validating the positive price setup. The stock continues to trade comfortably above its 20 and 50 DEMA, while the RSI has generated a bullish crossover, highlighting improving price momentum.

title: Trade Spotlight: How should you trade Sagility, Graphite India, Axis Bank, Apollo Hospitals, Oberoi Realty, TD Power Systems, and others on September 1?
